title: VL-RewardBench: A Challenging Benchmark for Vision-Language Generative Reward Models
authors_zh: Lei Li、Yuancheng Wei、Zhihui Xie、Xuqing Yang、Yifan Song、Peiyi Wang、Chenxin An、Tianyu Liu、Sujian Li、Bill Yuchen Lin、Lingpeng Kong、Qi Liu
paper_type_zh: 视觉语言生成奖励模型基准
best_for_zh: 需要评测多模态奖励模型、judge 或候选答案重排器的研究者
one_line: VL-RewardBench is a 1,250-example human-verified benchmark that stress-tests vision-language generative reward models on perception, hallucination, and reasoning.
1,250 个经人工核验的图文偏好样本覆盖感知、幻觉与数学推理，是多模态生成奖励模型的核心评测数据。
why: It separates basic visual-perception failures, hallucinations, and reasoning failures in a public preference benchmark.
inclusion_reason: VL-RewardBench supplies human-verified multimodal preference labels for evaluating and improving vision-language reward models.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Existing multimodal reward models are often evaluated on preferences from conventional visual question answering, with labels automatically produced by another AI. Such samples may be too easy or inherit judge bias and do not reveal whether models can detect hallucinations, basic perception failures, or complex multimodal reasoning errors.

VL-RewardBench uses AI-assisted hard-example selection followed by human verification to curate 1,250 high-quality image–text preference instances spanning general multimodal queries, visual hallucination, and complex reasoning, and evaluates vision-language generative reward models with pairwise accuracy.

现有多模态奖励模型多在传统视觉问答偏好上评测，标签常由另一个 AI 自动生成，样本容易过于简单或继承 judge 偏差，无法判断模型是否真正识别视觉幻觉、基本感知错误和复杂多模态推理失误。

VL-RewardBench 通过 AI 辅助难例筛选与人工复核构造 1,250 个高质量图文偏好实例，覆盖通用多模态、视觉幻觉和复杂推理，用统一 pairwise accuracy 检验视觉语言生成式奖励模型。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: VL-RewardBench uses AI-assisted hard-example selection followed by human verification to curate 1,250 high-quality image–text preference instances spanning general multimodal queries, visual hallucination, and complex reasoning, and evaluates vision-language generative reward models with pairwise accuracy. VL-RewardBench contains 1,250 human-verified preference examples across general multimodal, hallucination, and complex-reasoning domains. Each record links an image and question to two candidate responses and a preference label, with source or error-type metadata for some subsets. The official release is an evaluation benchmark rather than a large training corpus.

VL-RewardBench 通过 AI 辅助难例筛选与人工复核构造 1,250 个高质量图文偏好实例，覆盖通用多模态、视觉幻觉和复杂推理，用统一 pairwise accuracy 检验视觉语言生成式奖励模型。VL-RewardBench 含 1,250 个经人工核验的偏好样本，覆盖 general multimodal、hallucination 和 complex reasoning 三大域；每条记录关联图像、问题、两个候选回答及偏好标签，部分样本还保留错误类型或来源信息。官方数据集用于 evaluation，不是大规模训练语料。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Build the source pool: Collect candidates from multiple vision-language tasks and model-response pools, using automatic scores or rules to prioritize confusing hard response pairs.
  1. Generate or reorganize feedback: Organize general-question, hallucination, and complex-reasoning subsets while controlling pair differences so length or formatting alone is insufficient.
  1. Verify and filter: Have humans verify the image, question, candidate responses, and preference label against visual evidence; discard cases without reliable adjudication.
  1. Train and evaluate: Evaluate 16 LVLMs with order-randomized pairwise judging and validate the benchmark through accuracy and correlation with downstream Best-of-N results.

1. 建立数据源： 从多个视觉语言任务与模型回答池中收集候选，并用自动评分或规则优先定位容易混淆的高难 response pairs。
  1. 生成或重组反馈： 按通用问答、幻觉检测和复杂推理组织子集，控制正负回答差异，避免只靠长度或格式判断。
  1. 验证与筛选： 由人工复核图像、问题和候选答案，确认偏好标签与视觉证据一致；无法可靠判定的样本被删除。
  1. 训练与评测： 以候选顺序随机化的 pairwise judging 提示评测 16 个 LVLM，并用准确率及与 Best-of-N 下游结果的相关性验证 benchmark。

title: Evidence
证据
html: Across 16 leading vision-language models, even GPT-4o reaches only 65.4% accuracy and Qwen2-VL-72B remains near random, indicating that the benchmark is not saturated. VL-RewardBench scores correlate above 0.9 with MMMU-Pro Best-of-N accuracy using the corresponding reward model, and training a 7B judge improves accuracy by 14.7 points. These results support the central claim only under the released data, model scales, candidate budgets, and evaluation protocols; cross-domain use requires new validation.

在 16 个主流视觉语言模型上，GPT-4o 也只有 65.4% 准确率，Qwen2-VL-72B 接近随机水平，说明数据不是被模型轻易饱和。VL-RewardBench 得分与使用相应 reward model 在 MMMU-Pro 上进行 Best-of-N 的准确率相关系数超过 0.9；训练一个 7B judge 后准确率提高 14.7 点。 这些结果支持论文的核心主张，但只适用于其公开数据、模型规模、候选预算和评测协议；跨领域使用仍需重新验证。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior visual reward benchmarks largely reuse ordinary tasks and AI labels. This work explicitly selects cases that expose perception, hallucination, and reasoning weaknesses of VL-GenRMs, and checks both label reliability through human verification and evaluation validity through downstream BoN correlation.
已有视觉 reward benchmark 主要复用普通任务及 AI 标签；本文把样本选择目标改为专门暴露 VL-GenRM 的感知、幻觉与推理弱点，并用人工验证和下游 BoN 相关性同时检验标签可信度与评价效度。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Coverage boundary: The 1,250 examples support diagnosis rather than exhaustive visual-domain coverage; fine-grained OCR, video, and specialist imagery may be underrepresented.
  1. Feedback risk: Pairwise labels collapse multiple error types, and a single chosen/rejected decision cannot express uncertainty when both responses are wrong or partially correct.
  1. Reproduction and use: The public benchmark may be used for tuning or training; users should disclose exposure and retain hidden or temporal splits.

1. 覆盖边界： 1,250 条数据适合诊断而非覆盖所有视觉领域，细粒度 OCR、视频和专业图像仍可能不足。
  1. 反馈风险： pairwise 标签压缩了多种错误类型；若两回答都错或都部分正确，单一 chosen/rejected 不能表达不确定性。
  1. 复现与使用： 公开 benchmark 可能被用于调参或训练，复用时应报告是否接触过测试集并保留隐藏或时间切分。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Evaluation: Evaluate multimodal ORMs, generative RMs, or LLM judges and report results separately for perception, hallucination, and reasoning subsets.
  1. Training: Use it as a pre-training diagnostic to determine whether an RM mainly lacks visual recognition or logical comparison capability.
  1. Transfer or deployment: Verify whether a new RM improves downstream BoN with an independent policy and fixed candidate budget rather than reporting benchmark accuracy alone.

1. 评测： 评测多模态 ORM、GenRM 或 LLM-as-a-Judge，并按感知、幻觉和推理子集报告结果。
  1. 训练： 用作训练前诊断集，确定 reward model 更缺视觉识别还是逻辑比较能力。
  1. 迁移或部署： 验证新 RM 是否真正改善下游 BoN；必须使用独立 policy 和固定候选预算，不能只报告 benchmark accuracy。
